pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft, non-linear edge gradients. Patch area is heterogeneous, with larger, more complex geometries on the lateral flank and smaller, more fragmented regions on the shoulder and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a non-rectilinear grid. Pixel width varies from narrow dividers on the flank to wider channels on the neck, characterized by a high density of tri-junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile along the neck mane. Individual hair follicle clusters create a jagged 1D contour against the sky/background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized interruption in the continuous mane silhouette is visible at the transition point between the neck and the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Multiple small, hyper-pigmented nodules with raised textural relief are visible along the upper dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, localized area of textural disruption and epidermal thickening with a greyish-brown appearance is visible on the posterior rump near the tail insertion.
